links.outcome: Adenoma per colonoscopy and adenoma detection rate with CADe versus routine colonoscopy in real-world practice
links.effect: Mean APC 0.602 vs 0.293 (rate ratio 1.80 [1.40–2.32]); ADR 30.4% vs 16.8% (adjusted RR 1.68 [1.27–2.22]); no significant difference in withdrawal time.
links.quote: The CADe system was found to significantly increase the mean APC (0.602 vs. 0.293; rate ratio 1.80 [1.40–2.32]; P < 0.001) and ADR, 30.4% with CADe versus 16.8% without CADe (adjusted RR 1.68 [1.27–2.22], P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment effectiveness of a computer-aided detection (CADe) tool (GI Genius) in routine colonoscopy compared to standard colonoscopy, without testing specific deployment safeguards or governance practices.
